_about: Gilbert Burnet (1643-1715), Bishop of Salisbury: The History of the Reformation of the Church of England, ed. Nicholas Pocock (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1865, 7 vols), with the Collection of Records. Volume numbers read off each title page. Volume 6 is largely Latin Records, so its share of common English words is low; that is content, not bad OCR. Named gilbert-burnet so Frances Hodgson Burnett's shelf (burnett) cannot be mistaken for it. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
